versions.changelog:
ceaser-send v1.3.0

- Updated SKILL.md for clearer structure and extended instructions; improved clarity around pre-flight checks, privacy warnings, and wallet generation phase.
- Helpers/wallet-ops.js modified (details not included here).
- No changes to protocol logic or privacy warnings, but documentation and flow explanation are more detailed for user guidance.
- No user-facing behavior changes outside documentation.

Fix invalid BytesLike error: sign-and-send now auto-reads unsigned TX from ~/.ceaser-mcp/pending-tx.json instead of requiring long hex data as CLI arg. File is cleaned up after successful send. Updated ceaser-mcp to v1.2.0.
Add explicit ceaser-mcp MCP tool references in description for better compatibility with less capable models.
Initial release: auto-signing mode with ephemeral hot wallet, privacy warning, randomized gas buffers
